name: alphasafal-skills
description: Evaluated, portable Agent Skills for engineering, SRE, security, data and product roles. Install everything, or just your role's pack.

plugins.name: production-agent-skills
plugins.description: Fifteen evaluated Agent Skills for engineering, frontend, SRE, security, data and product work: test-first development, specs and plans, UI review, debugging, code review, incident response, deploy pipeline review, threat modeling, security audits, repo mapping, system design review, data science, decisions with ADRs, PRDs and shipping features.

plugins.name: backend-engineer
plugins.description: Backend / full-stack engineer pack: Understand a codebase, ship features test-first, debug what breaks, review what merges. Skills: repo-architect, feature-to-production, test-first-developer, debugging-investigator, production-code-review.

plugins.name: frontend-engineer
plugins.description: Frontend engineer pack: Accessible, resilient UI: review components for a11y, states and Core Web Vitals, build test-first, ship safely. Skills: frontend-ui-reviewer, test-first-developer, feature-to-production, production-code-review.

plugins.name: tech-lead
plugins.description: Tech lead / architect pack: Plan work as vertical slices, review designs before they're built, make decisions you can defend, hold the review bar. Skills: spec-and-plan, system-design-reviewer, research-to-decision, production-code-review, repo-architect, threat-modeler.

plugins.name: sre
plugins.description: SRE / DevOps pack: Run incidents, keep the deploy pipeline safe, find root causes after the fire is out. Skills: incident-responder, deploy-pipeline-reviewer, debugging-investigator.

plugins.name: security
plugins.description: Security engineer pack: Threat-model designs before they're built, audit code before it launches, review risky diffs. Skills: threat-modeler, security-auditor, production-code-review.

plugins.name: data-scientist
plugins.description: Data scientist / analyst pack: Rigorous analysis and modeling with leakage checks and baselines; decisions backed by evidence. Skills: data-scientist, research-to-decision.

plugins.name: product-manager
plugins.description: Product manager pack: Turn vague ideas into right-sized MVPs and PRDs, decide with evidence, read the data. Skills: product-manager, research-to-decision, data-scientist.
